Image-generation material asset, 2026-10-27.
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Flat, orthographic warm pale ivory limestone diffuse albedo scan. Fine mineral pores, subtle aged chisel scratches and hairline veins; restrained cream/grey variation. Uniform diffuse illumination, full bleed. No blocks, joints, objects, sculptures, text, logos, baked lighting, shadows, perspective or highlights. Used as the stone color/bump texture in the detailed source scene.
Generated bitmap: 1254 x 1254 pixels. Copied non-destructively into limestone-detail-v1.webp. Additional carved geometry is implemented in scene.js, not painted into this texture.
